Dolgan Outpost is occupied by Mechon.[XENO:n ]
Defeat their leader and take control of the facility.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Prudent Purson[/System:Color] at Dolgan Outpost.
The Dolgan Outpost is now under your control.

Enalda Control Base is occupied by Mechon.[XENO:n ]
Defeat their leader and take control of the facility.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Tranquil Morax[/System:Color] at the Enalda Control[XENO:n ]
Base.
Enalda Control Base is now under your control.

Mechon reinforcements have arrived at Gate 3.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the Large Mechon and hold off their forces.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Reinforcement M104[/System:Color] near Gate 3.

The war situation has improved a lot as a result[XENO:n ]
of you defeating the Mechon reinforcements.

The area around the Radio Tower has been occupied[XENO:n ]
by the enemy. The war effort would benefit from their[XENO:n ]
leader being removed.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Lightning Ronve[/System:Color] who is in the area[XENO:n ]
around the Radio Tower.

You helped the war effort by defeating the leader[XENO:n ]
of the enemies around the Radio Tower.

The Homs and the Mechon are at war! Use the[XENO:n ]
only weapon that has any effect on the Mechon -[XENO:n ]
the Monado to defeat some of the Mechon nearby.
Defeat 3 Mechon in the vicinity.
You cleared all the nearby Mechon!

Dunban and the Monado are the only hope for[XENO:n ]
survival that the Homs have left. Use the mighty[XENO:n ]
Monado to defeat the Mechon reinforcements.
Defeat 3 Mechon reinforcements.
You cleared all the Mechon reinforcements!

The Mechon just keep coming. But even if it costs[XENO:n ]
your life, there is no way you're going to run![XENO:n ]
Keep battling the extra Mechon reinforcements!
Defeat the Mechon M82.
You cleared all the extra Mechon reinforcements!
